title: chat-filenode: chatspace role vs filenode-20 one-role-per-account
description: Editor's draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-20 (unposted as of 2026-11-01, ~/GIT/draft-gondwana-jmap-filenode) adds: 'At most one Directory in an account has a given role.' draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 gives every Space root role 'chatspace', so two Spaces whose trees live in the same account would violate it. Act when -20 is posted. Options: per-Space files account (removes the role entirely), or a non-role marker. -20 also lets clients set/clear role with mayRename; our existing chatspace role-immutability rule remains a valid server policy refusal.
